en-US.description: Your AI agent for subtitles & video
en-US.longDescription: Tell the agent what you want, or do it by hand. BaoCut 2 transcribes on your computer, translates subtitles that fit the screen, and dubs your video into another language in the speaker’s own voice.
en-US.name: BaoCut (Vulkan)
en-US.releaseNotes:
BaoCut 3.19.1 (build 96)
Video downloads
- When YouTube reports a sign-in check, expired account cookies or a failed n/signature challenge before ending with "Requested format is not available", the download now fails as a login (LINK_LOGIN_REQUIRED) or tool-update (LINK_TOOL_UPDATE_REQUIRED) problem and shows that cause, instead of reporting the link as unavailable. The cause survives long format-probe logs, and a concrete final error such as HTTP 403 or a timeout still takes priority. Error codes, browser selection and retry rules are unchanged. (#137 by XiChuan9)
- Links in download error messages and details are redacted more reliably, including links with raw quotes in their credentials and links cut off by the log length limit. (source)
Command line
- The top-level baocut help fits within 40 lines again. (#136)
Requirements and verification limits
- macOS: Apple Silicon, macOS 14 or later; signed and notarized packages are published after native validation.
- Windows: unsigned packages; AVX2 and the Microsoft Visual C++ v14 x64 Redistributable are required. CUDA/Vulkan variants require compatible GPU drivers.
- ffmpeg/ffprobe and an agent engine remain external dependencies.
- Automated release checks do not cover full UI/export workflows, live model or GPU inference, live YouTube downloads, or paid agent calls.
Source coverage
Changes since 3.19.0 build 95, 6 commits, 2 associated PRs, reviewed in one batch with complete source coverage. Prior-release feed/Homebrew updates are included in the source inventory and omitted from highlights. The release preparation commit only updates package versions and these notes.
Full comparison
Platform verification
BaoCut 3.19.1 (Build 96) for Apple Silicon, macOS 14+.
Bundle ID: com.baocut.app. Developer ID signed, hardened runtime and Apple notarization accepted for both App and DMG.
Runtime and native Worker startup, signer fingerprint, staple and Gatekeeper checks passed. UI/export, real model inference and paid Agent calls were not exercised by this workflow. ffmpeg/ffprobe and an agent engine are external dependencies.
Source: ac3076ef492450d72c1ed89856a36ea659591eff
Actions: https://github.com/JimLiu/baocut/actions/runs/42965860533
Windows x64
Variants: cpu, cuda, vulkan. NSIS installers and portable ZIPs, and the standalone command line ZIPs (BaoCut-CLI-…), are unsigned. Real credential migration and model/Agent/GPU inference were not exercised by the installer tests. Requires the Microsoft Visual C++ v14 x64 Redistributable; the current package does not bundle the VC runtime DLLs.
Native build and installer verification: https://github.com/JimLiu/baocut/actions/runs/42965860533
